headlines.text: It was 2024 when Orange Cassidy vs. Dante Martin went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.48. This stood as the 30th match in AEW International Title history ? a real landmark for that championship. Cassidy fought off a spirited Top Flight challenger to retain the International Title with the Orange Punch, as Darius Martin and Action Andretti checked on a fallen Dante afterward.
It was 2026 when Hechicero vs. Komander met in an Eliminator Match on Collision, rated 7.48 ? a well-worked match.
On this day in 2024, both Queen Aminata and Mariah May made their official debuts under the AEW banner, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.33. A memorable debut from both women!

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2024, when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Darby Allin delivered a match fans still talk about on Dynamite, rated 8.60.
Back on this day in 2026, Darby Allin vs. Wheeler Yuta headlined Collision, rated 6.85.
On a Wednesday in 2024, back when Swerve Strickland vs. Daniel Garcia headlined Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a good, competitive contest in a hard-fought men's division clash.
